pieces:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production sprite atlas for a native Japanese shogi game, NOT a UI mockup.
Input image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match the broad golden wooden pentagonal shogi pieces in its board, not the surrounding UI.
Create a transparent PNG sprite atlas, square 1536x1536, exactly 4 columns x 4 rows, 16 equal square slots. In every occupied slot place one SINGLE UPRIGHT piece, centered, perfectly top-down orthographic, point at TOP. Identical perceived body size and silhouette for all 15 pieces, each body approximately 260 px wide by 310 px high (height/width 1.19), generous clear transparent gaps; no overlap, no slot lines. Last slot bottom right EMPTY/transparent.
Pieces should have broad bases, short sloping shoulders, a small central point; golden honey yellow face with subtle vertical wood grain, pale gold upper right rim highlight, deep burnt orange bevel on left and bottom, narrow dark brown outline and a subtle short dark shadow directly beneath. Match reference's bold elegant BLACK single-character brush kanji, very legible at phone size. Face light yellow/gold, not pale beige. All piece faces identical hue and size, no perspective tilt.
EXACT characters in reading order, left to right, top to bottom:
row1: 歩 | 香 | 桂 | 銀
row2: 金 | 角 | 飛 | 玉
row3: 王 | と | 杏 | 圭
row4: 全 | 馬 | 龍 | [empty].
The first NINE glyphs are pure black. The final SIX promoted glyphs と 杏 圭 全 馬 龍 are dark vivid RED cinnabar, never black.
Each piece bears ONLY the specified ONE character, no labels, no extra text, no number, no watermarks. Brush text must be correct Japanese kanji. Keep the atlas background truly alpha-transparent, do not paint a checkerboard. Pieces and shadows only. This atlas will be cropped programmatically; honor 4x4 regular grid and keep every glyph attached within its own piece.
board:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: single production shogi BOARD TEXTURE bitmap for a native Android game; not a screenshot.
Input image1 is reference for the warm amber/honey board colors and thin copper-orange edge. Create ONE EMPTY flat wooden game board viewed from directly overhead, straight orthographic, no perspective. Portrait aspect approximately 1:1.05, 1024 wide x 1072 high.
The interior is luminous honey yellow-orange wood, subtle fine vertical grain, gentle amber glow and a few darker amber waves at edges. Include exceptionally faint original Japanese misty mountain silhouettes and a distant little pagoda along the lower third, subtle enough that black piece glyphs remain legible. A very thin continuous beveled burnt orange/copper wooden frame around all four outside edges (about 1% image width); crisp rectangular corners.
IMPORTANT: The entire interior is EMPTY WOOD: NO grid lines (the application draws the mathematically precise 9x9 grid), NO pieces, NO kanji, NO text, NO circles, NO logos, NO UI, NO black background outside. The board rectangle exactly fills the image to its edges. Rich warm color consistent with reference, no cold gray or pink and no thick ornamental border. Keep grain subtle at phone screen size. Opaque image.
